name: LMS Brand Settings
description: Desk-side configuration for the operator's brand. The values here are mirrored to site_config.json and to Website Settings / System Settings on every save, so the login page, portal navbar, desk chrome, and email footers can never drift. See docs/BRAND_QUICKSTART.md for the full reference.

fields.options: Set the operator's product brand. Values are written to site_config.json and to Website Settings / System Settings on every save. Use the same setter via the CLI: bench --site <site> execute lms_saas.utils.brand.set_brand --kwargs '{"portal_title": "Your Brand"}'.

fields.label: Portal Title (operator's brand name)
fields.description: The operator's product brand name (e.g. 'Acme Capital'). Shows on the login page, portal navbar, desk title bar, and email subjects. Default: 'LMS' (vendor-neutral).

fields.label: Tagline
fields.description: One-line under-brand text. Shows on the login page brand panel.

fields.label: Product Subtitle
fields.description: Subtitle shown on the login card and portal boot.

fields.label: Footer Text
fields.description: Portal footer copy. Pass empty to hide the footer.

fields.label: Primary Color
fields.description: Hex colour for the portal accent (e.g. #2f4f46).

fields.label: Support Email
fields.description: Operator support address (shown in the portal footer).

fields.label: UI Theme
fields.description: Active UI theme. Switches the portal CSS theme (default / midnight / dark).

fields.options: Optional brand assets. If unset, the bundled mark + favicon are used.

fields.label: Logo Path
fields.description: Operator-supplied logo asset path (e.g. /files/kesari-logo.svg). Leave empty to use the bundled mark.

fields.label: Favicon Path
fields.description: Operator-supplied favicon path (e.g. /files/kesari-favicon.svg). Leave empty to use the bundled favicon.
